R1.description: A backup file contains every workout session: completed, abandoned and running, with exercises and sets

R2.description: Restoring running and abandoned sessions brings them back unchanged, the running one active

R3.description: The restore confirmation warns that a running workout will be deleted, only when one exists

R4.description: If it cannot be told whether a workout is running, the warning is shown

R5.description: If a session can't be read, Export backup reports the failure, opens no file picker and doesn't crash
